SEVEN FIELDS · ONE QUESTION LIBRARY
Choose a field, or search every study below. Reformed theology remains a field of questions, linked to its path and historic works.
25 studies
Semantic search: a small model on your device, free and private. Turn on · 85 MB once How it works
Does the Trinity mean three gods?
One God, eternally Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
Was Jesus simply a great teacher?
The eternal Son became truly human to save sinners.
Why would forgiveness involve the cross?
Christ willingly bore the judgment our sins deserve.
Does the resurrection really matter?
Christ rose bodily. Our forgiveness and hope depend on it.
What does it mean to say the Bible is trustworthy?
God's written Word is our final authority for faith and life.
If salvation is a gift, why do good works matter?
Justified by faith alone; renewed for a life of obedience.
Why is there something rather than nothing?
Creation depends on the self-existent God.
Can we be good without believing in God?
No one is righteous by nature. God's image remains, and common grace is real.
Has science made God unnecessary?
The world we investigate is sustained by its Creator.
Can a reasonable person believe in miracles?
God acts in his world; not every remarkable report is true.
Has the Bible been changed beyond recognition?
Trust God's preservation and examine the actual manuscript witnesses.
Who decided which books belong in the Bible?
The church recognises God's Word; it does not give it authority.
What should we do with apparent Bible contradictions?
Trust the truthful God and read his Word carefully.
How can a good God allow suffering?
God is sovereign and good; evil is real, and Christ is our hope.
Why does God sometimes seem absent?
Bring darkness to God; anchor assurance in Christ.
What about the harm Christians have done?
Tell the truth about sin. Christ's name must never shield wrongdoing.
Do Christians and Muslims mean the same thing by Jesus?
Shared names do not remove the decisive question of his identity.
How can Christians defend the Trinity to a Muslim neighbour?
Confess one God clearly and explain the real disagreement.
What separates Christian and Islamic accounts of the cross?
Christ's death and resurrection are essential to the gospel.
How should Christians engage secular thought?
Honour image-bearers while making the gospel's claim clear.
How do we defend the faith without becoming combative?
Christ is Lord; our witness should be truthful, gentle and clear.
What is Reformed theology, and why does it matter for apologetics?
A connected account of Scripture, God, grace and the Christian life, with Scripture judging every teacher.
If God chooses, do our choices and witness matter?
Hold God’s sovereign grace together with real responsibility and the call to preach Christ.
How does covenant theology connect the whole Bible?
Follow God’s promises to their fulfillment in Christ without flattening the differences between the covenants.
Can a struggling Christian have assurance of salvation?
Distinguish Christ’s preserving promise, the reality of living faith and the believer’s changing sense of assurance.
Conviction with an open Bible. Scripture first. Reformed convictions. Sources you can examine.
Rooted in Scripture. Open for discovery.
A place to read slowly, ask deeply, and follow the connections. Scripture, study and the voices of Christian history, brought together for a lifetime of learning.
